selection_rule: For each episode choose zero-based floor(N/4), floor(N/2), floor(3N/4) supplied transcript windows. Freeze explicit named or uniquely contextual game/product reference buckets before viewing extraction. Preserve no-title windows. Platform/edition identities distinct when contrasted; same source game can satisfy underlying and novel-variant buckets only if its evidence preserves the difference. Hardware, films, magazines, unnamed aggregate system sets and music excluded.
limits: Deterministic bounded source-first sample; not a blind statistical archive recall estimate. Adjacent source consulted for Gremlins, Arachnophobia novel and Layers of Fear context only; not extraction records.
